title: Cult-Werk Rear Conversion kit "Bagger" V1 (Touring CVO 2023 & Touring 2024)
text: The Cult-Werk Rear Conversion Kit "Bagger" V1 is a comprehensive upgrade designed for Harley-Davidson Touring CVO 2023 and Touring 2024 models. It includes a rear fender with cutouts for the original rear lights, a long case, and side covers, all crafted from high-quality ABS plastic using advanced 5-axis CNC machining for OEM-level precision. The kit allows reuse of the factory rear and license plate lights without altering connections. Installation involves fitting the ABS fender over the original metal fender, secured with original screws and supplied brackets. LED lights are installed separately with adhesive before final assembly. Available in a paint-ready finish for easy customization or glossy black for a no-paint option. The package contains the ABS rear fender, glossy black side case, mounting hardware, and reinforcement brackets.

title: Cult-Werk Rear Fender "Bagger" V1 (Touring CVO 2023 & Touring 2024)
text: The Cult-Werk Rear Fender "Bagger" V1 is a complete upgrade kit designed for Harley-Davidson Touring CVO 2023 and Touring 2024 models. This plug-and-play ABS fender fits directly over the original, allowing continued use of the factory rear and license plate lights.
